reference: Binder J, Koller D, Russell S, Kanazawa K (1997). "Adaptive Probabilistic Networks with Hidden Variables." Machine Learning, 29(2–3):213–244.
context: Insurance is a synthetic Bayesian network for evaluating car insurance risks. It describes driver demographics and behavior, vehicle characteristics and safety features, accident/theft outcomes, and resulting cost buckets.

variables.name: GoodStudent
variables.description: Good student; whether the driver is considered a good student (levels: False, True).

variables.name: Age
variables.description: Age; driver's age group category (levels: Adolescent, Adult, Senior).

variables.name: SocioEcon
variables.description: Socio-economic status; coarse household/driver socio-economic category (levels: Prole, Middle, UpperMiddle, Wealthy).

variables.name: RiskAversion
variables.description: Risk aversion; tendency toward risk-taking vs caution (levels: Psychopath, Adventurous, Normal, Cautious).

variables.name: VehicleYear
variables.description: Vehicle age; whether the vehicle is from the current model year or older (levels: Current, older).

variables.name: ThisCarDam
variables.description: Damage to this car; severity of damage to the insured car (levels: None, Mild, Moderate, Severe).

variables.name: RuggedAuto
variables.description: Ruggedness of the car; how physically rugged the vehicle is (levels: EggShell, Football, Tank).

variables.name: Accident
variables.description: Severity of the accident; overall accident severity outcome (levels: None, Mild, Moderate, Severe).

variables.name: MakeModel
variables.description: Car's model; broad car type/class (levels: SportsCar, Economy, FamilySedan, Luxury, SuperLuxury).

variables.name: DrivQuality
variables.description: Driving quality; overall driving quality category (levels: Poor, Normal, Excellent).

variables.name: Mileage
variables.description: Mileage; usage/miles-driven bucket (levels: FiveThou, TwentyThou, FiftyThou, Domino).

variables.name: Antilock
variables.description: ABS; whether the car has an antilock braking system (levels: False, True).

variables.name: DrivingSkill
variables.description: Driving skill; driver skill level category (levels: SubStandard, Normal, Expert).

variables.name: SeniorTrain
variables.description: Senior training; whether the driver has senior driver training (levels: False, True).

variables.name: ThisCarCost
variables.description: Costs for the insured car; cost bucket for the insured car’s claim/repair costs (levels: Thousand, TenThou, HundredThou, Million).

variables.name: Theft
variables.description: Theft; whether the insured car is stolen (levels: False, True).

variables.name: CarValue
variables.description: Value of the car; insured car value bucket (levels: FiveThou, TenThou, TwentyThou, FiftyThou, Million).

variables.name: HomeBase
variables.description: Neighbourhood type; home/neighbourhood category (levels: Secure, City, Suburb, Rural).

variables.name: AntiTheft
variables.description: Anti-theft system; whether the car has an anti-theft system (levels: False, True).

variables.name: PropCost
variables.description: Ratio of the cost for the two cars; proportional/relative cost bucket comparing the two cars (levels: Thousand, TenThou, HundredThou, Million).

variables.name: OtherCarCost
variables.description: Costs for the other car; cost bucket for the other car’s claim/repair costs (levels: Thousand, TenThou, HundredThou, Million).

variables.name: OtherCar
variables.description: Other cars involved in the accident; whether another car is involved (levels: False, True).

variables.name: MedCost
variables.description: Cost of the medical treatment; medical cost bucket associated with injuries/treatment (levels: Thousand, TenThou, HundredThou, Million).

variables.name: Cushioning
variables.description: Cushioning; protection/cushioning quality in the car (levels: Poor, Fair, Good, Excellent).

variables.name: Airbag
variables.description: Airbag; whether the car has airbags (levels: False, True).

variables.name: ILiCost
variables.description: Inspection cost; inspection cost bucket (levels: Thousand, TenThou, HundredThou, Million).

variables.name: DrivHist
variables.description: Driving history; bucketed driving history/incidents count (levels: Zero, One, Many).
